# TabLabelRotation

`Flare.Components.TabLabelRotation`

Rotation applied to each tab's label in FlareTabs.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `None` | `0` | No rotation (0 degrees). Default. |
| `Rotate90` | `1` | Rotate the label 90 degrees clockwise. |
| `Rotate180` | `2` | Rotate the label 180 degrees (upside down). |
| `Rotate270` | `3` | Rotate the label 270 degrees clockwise (90 counter-clockwise). |

## Used by components

- `FlareTabs`
